Övergripande fråga: Resultat kopplat till avsedd effekt 2013Fråga: Sammanfatta resultat relaterade till avsedd effekt (denna information kommer att skickas till Open Aid).Svar: This is a human rights education program targeted to young people between the age of 15-35 in 37 selected districts of Pakistan covering all five provinces as well as Azad Jammu Kashmir region. This program is the extension of Know Your Rights which was successfully implemented in 18 districts of Pakistan during the year 2010 -2011. This project has been designed with a vision to bring human rights education into the mainstream of youth work and policy. This project aims to provide human rights education using non-formal learning tools to enable youth and empower them to strive for establishment of a pluralistic and democratic society where all the Human Rights are protected and promoted. This program targets young people and aims at enhancing their role in advocating for Human Rights and democracy in their private lives and in their work. This is achieved by providing non-formal educational/learning tools. The results progress report shows a clear progress towards the overarching goals of the contribution. The trainers have been selected from different parts of Pakistan and trained in Human Rights Education. The trainings included workshops on issues such as Peace and Violence and Gender, participant led discussions, lectures on debriefing and evaluation and other issues, group projects etcetera. YPP has successfully organised 31 Know Your Rights sessions, covering the majority of the districts. Computers have been offered for the different districts participating in the program and the website of the Human Rights Education is up and running. Information will be continuously uploaded on the site as the project continues.
